output.methodChoice: Applied the supplied diagnostic sequence internally. Collected 3 items: X11 (platform audit trail), X8 (internal audit recalculation), X1 (overtime cover dashboard). Read nothing else.
output.brief:
Anika, the October errors came from a pay-rule setting, not from your data. On 22 Oct an Ardentra consultant applied a template to the night premium rule; logged as a label fix, it also moved the premium start from 20:00 to 22:00. The platform's own audit trail shows this, and the setting was 20:00 in both trial runs. Internal Audit found 147 of 158 night workers underpaid (8 never complained), each short by exactly the 20:00–22:00 hours at the premium rate. Resetting that one setting in the test system, with the same data and software, fixed all 158. Ardentra's data explanation fails: flagged records were no likelier to be underpaid. I'm about 95% sure.

Don't approve Malcolm's package: it punishes the wrong team, reloads data needlessly and concedes cost. Instead, restore the 20:00 window before 24 Nov, verify it independently, and pay all 147 off-cycle. Don't roll back release 7.4; it carries November's tax update and isn't implicated. Hold off pausing the rota trial: the night overtime drop fits both the pay errors and the trial, and the data can't separate them. Fix pay, then watch cover.
